insurance.note: North-star loop NL18 (ADR-0042 amendment 3): test policies on OnyxParametric. Products, the pool and the outcome are read from the chain; payouts settle from the value observers record, never from a vote. Its `markets` are open on the guarded futures (NL23): the same contract as the first futures, but insiders may not bet and trading closes before the source publishes.
